messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER -> SEV2: sudden spike in 502/504 from edge tier (api.redwood.internal). 7.8% of requests failing in last 3m, multiple customer error reports. Pager sent to oncall.
Jordan (oncall): ack — I'm on it. Starting triage. @Ava can you pull edge LB + gateway pool stats? I'll check recent deploys and routing.
Ava L: looking now. Edge LB shows a surge of upstream timeouts to gateway-v2 pool, ~30% of upstream connections resetting. gateway-03 CPU at 95% and many CLOSE_WAIT. Logs show repeated "upstream reset" and "connection refused".
Sanjay P: running quick query on logs -> found pattern: a subset of long-poll requests (>30s) correlating with spikes. Here's sample from gateway-03:
```
[2026-03-15T14:12:03Z] upstream error: connection reset by peer, id=abcd1234, route=gateway-v2
[2026-03-15T14:12:04Z] upstream timeout: read timeout after 30s, req=/v1/generate
```
Mike R: last infra change was a routing weight tweak and a canary to gateway-v2 ~14:05 UTC (today). DeployBot: last deploy to gateway-v2 @1753102300 by mike-r — rollback available: https://ci.redwood/internal/deploys/1753102300
Jordan (oncall): mitigation plan (quick): 1) pull down traffic weight to gateway-v2, 2) enable short-circuit 503->cached responses for non-critical routes, 3) apply temporary rate-limits for heavy clients, 4) if errors persist, failover region. Starting with #1.
Ava L: applying routing weight change via control plane. API call:
```
curl -X POST "https://control.redwood.internal/v1/route/update" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"route":"/v1/*","pools":{"gateway-v2":0.1,"gateway-v1":0.9}}'
```
OpsBot: executing routing update -> posted new weights: gateway-v2=0.1, gateway-v1=0.9. Rolling update applied to edge proxies.
Support-Counsel: inbound support tickets reporting 502s on POST /v1/generate. Volume up ~12/min. Major customers A and C opened tickets.
Taylor (SRE): metrics after weight change: error rate down from 7.8% -> 1.3% in 90s. Tail latency improving. Still seeing 504s from long queries; suspect backend worker saturation on gateway-v2 prior to shift.
Jordan (oncall): good progress. Next: enable temporary per-client rate-limit for the heaviest clients to protect backend and reduce retries. @Mike can you coordinate a quick rule? Also add a brief 5-min maintenance notice on status.redwood.
Mike R: adding rate-limit rule now (10r/s per client for /v1/generate) via edge config. Command:
```
edgectl policy add --route "/v1/generate" --type rate_limit --limit 10
```
OpsBot: rate limit applied to /v1/generate (10r/s). Monitoring.
Ava L: after rate limit + weight change errors holding ~0.9% and key customers report fewer failures. Rolling logs show gateway-v2 recovering; connection resets decreasing.
Support-Counsel: customers A & C acknowledged improvement. Escalations dropped.
Jordan (oncall): preparing handoff in 20m. Actions to include in handoff note:
- Root cause suspected: gateway-v2 overload due to long-poll heavy requests + recent routing/canary weighting.
- Immediate mitigation: reduced routing weight, applied per-route rate-limits, short-circuit policy for non-critical endpoints.
- Next steps: infra/eng-runtime to investigate connection pool and worker saturation on gateway-v2, look at canary rollout logs and revert/change rollout process.
- Owners: Mike R (routing/edge rules), Ava L (edge logs + recovery), Sanjay P (post-incident log analysis), Taylor (SRE) to follow infra metrics overnight.
Taylor (SRE): agreed. I'll continue monitoring for next 30m then file incident doc, link will be added. If error rate rises above 2% again, wake the oncall.
Jordan (oncall): handoff summary posted to #incidents-docs and incident created: https://docs.redwood/incidents/1753102468. Tagging postmortem owners. Good work team :thumbsup:
DeployBot: note — no code rollback performed; routing weight change only. If follow-up requires rollback, use deploy id 1753102300.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT -> MONITORING: error rate stable under 1% for 10m, transitioning to monitoring/verification phase. Handoff scheduled to Taylor (SRE) at 1753102868.
Jordan (oncall): handing off to Taylor. Short summary in thread above. If anything flares, page me directly.
